name: Labeled Faces in the Wild (LFW)
description: A landmark benchmark database for studying the problem of unconstrained face recognition and face verification. Developed by the Computer Vision Laboratory at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. Contains 13,233 web-collected face images of 5,749 distinct individuals, of which 1,680 people have two or more images. Serves as the quintessential academic evaluation benchmark for pair-matching face verification in natural environments.

license.notes: The canonical UMass Amherst distribution page (formerly vis-www.cs.umass.edu/lfw/) and accompanying technical report (Huang et al., 2007) do not publish a formal dataset license or research use agreement. The dataset was created for academic face recognition benchmarking using photographs collected from Yahoo News. No explicit commercial permission or restriction was granted by the publisher. Commercial usability remains unknown, and users must consider third-party copyright, privacy, and publicity rights.
